title: Building Bridges: A Peace Education Manual for Church Youth Leaders in the Democratic Republic of Congo
content: This booklet, Building Bridges: A Peace Education Manual for Church Youth Leaders in the Democratic Republic of Congo, represents a vital resource for fostering a culture of peace and reconciliation in a nation grappling with complex social, political, and environmental challenges. By addressing foundational aspects of peacebuilding and conflict resolution through the lens of biblical values, this manual equips youth leaders with the tools and understanding necessary to become catalysts for transformation in their communities.
